{{Infobox place|name=Thorn Hall|type=Seat of [[House Blackthorn]]|region=[[the Thornland]]|house=[[House Blackthorn]]|notable=The Game Hall; the Defeat Library; no straight wall to storm}}
'''Thorn Hall''' has no straight wall to storm: a sprawling, disorienting complex woven into the difficult terrain of [[the Thornland]], with gates that lead astray and false main courtyards. The defense is design, not walls. Its key rooms are '''the Game Hall''', whose floor is a game board, and '''the Defeat Library''' — a collection of failures, kept to be learned from. A black-thorned bush grows only here; it cuts whoever grabs it too hastily.
